listitem.simpara: Added: Network Config Strings (NCS) system to overcome engine gamestate size limits on large servers.
Added: deferred command system with per-client throttling to prevent reliable command buffer overflow during map changes and client connections.
Added: XCS phased sending for incremental delivery of mod data to connecting clients.
Added: g_oss CVAR for advertising supported platforms and architectures in the server browser.
Added: suppression of false skill and rank upgrade announcements during map changes using deferred CS_PLAYERS sending.
Improved: JXAC forced CVAR enforcement now re-sends corrections silently without flagging as violations.
Improved: JXAC CVAR scanning uses configurable batch sizes and rotating offsets for efficient checking of forced CVARs.
Improved: server stability on large servers by throttling configstring broadcasts and deferred sends.
Improved: documentation updated with all missing CVAR references for xmod-specific and JXAC anticheat settings.
